title: Positive comparison labels
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, define a map from the two comparison labels to the corresponding machine states: the label for the unary block maps to the state that clears the auxiliary register after that block, and the label for the doubled adjacency word maps to the state that clears it after that word.
